newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TAURAS BANK MUST REPAY SHARE ISSUE CASH.
newsitem.headline: TAURAS BANK MUST REPAY SHARE ISSUE CASH.

text.p: The securities commission said on Friday that Tauras Bank, which has had many of its operations suspended by the central bank, will have to repay people who subscribed to a new share issue by the bank.
The commission ruled that Tauras must first of all announce the central bank has suspended its operations.

"It (the announcment) must point out that investors who subscribed to the bank's shares before the information...was announced, have the right to break the agreements," the commission said in a statement.
It said Tauras Bank must repay any money in 10 days.
Tauras Bank said last month that it was facing liquidity problems and was pinning its hopes on the 40 million litas new share issue.
